result_text:
I added `DataStore.findOverduePurchaseOrdersOfSupplier(long supplierId, LocalDate date)` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, next to the warehouse version. The project compiles, but I didn't write or run a test for the new method.

It combines the existing overdue query with the supplier filter. So it returns only sent orders of that supplier expected strictly before the date. Draft, received and cancelled orders are excluded, and an order expected on the date itself is not overdue. Results are ordered by expected date, then id, and each order comes back with its lines.
